svg.title: Choose an acquisition route
svg.desc: Start with a permitted structured source; use parsing or scripted browsing when necessary. Interactive agent browsing supports exploration and small tasks.
svg.text: Use the first suitable, permitted route
Save a documented request and raw response
Fetch and parse a static page
Use the data already present in the HTML
Explore a site or complete a small visual task
Preserve a repeatable script when collection will recur
